note: Source packs live in the Downloads folder; scripts/build-weapons.py extracts what it needs. grip: metres to raise the weapon along its length before placing it in the hand (for meshes whose origin is at the pommel). hand: "l" holds the weapon in the left hand (bows). objects: mesh objects to keep from an FBX that holds several weapons. props: plain GLBs (the arrow projectile).
